name: RES Solar
old_description: RES Solar is New England’s solar hot water specialist, designing, repairing and installing custom solar hot water systems for homes and businesses from our Cohasset, Massachusetts headquarters. With more than 1000 solar hot water systems installed across the region, we know how to size, place, and tune a system to squeeze the most out of every ray. . Cleaner energy, lower bills, and a system built to last decades. That’s solar hot water, done right.
about:
RES Solar is based in Cohasset, Massachusetts, where it has established itself as New England's dedicated solar hot water specialist. The company designs, repairs, and installs custom solar hot water systems for both homes and businesses throughout the region. (Founding year and ownership details are not publicly disclosed.)

With more than 1,000 systems installed across New England, RES Solar has developed deep practical knowledge in sizing, placing, and tuning each installation to capture the maximum available solar energy. Its capabilities span the full project lifecycle: custom system design, professional installation, and ongoing repair and maintenance services.

The company serves residential and commercial property owners looking to reduce energy costs through solar thermal technology. Its customer base spans the New England area, addressing hot water needs for single-family homes, multi-unit buildings, and commercial facilities.

RES Solar states that its systems provide cleaner energy, lower bills, and a lifespan of decades, summarizing its value proposition as "solar hot water, done right." The firm's differentiation rests on its regional experience and focus on optimizing each system for local conditions.
